evals.prompt: Kartiere dieses TypeScript-Repository. Ich kenne den Code nicht und brauche pro Ordner eine codemap.md plus einen Einstiegspunkt.
evals.expected_output: A fresh mapping run: state detection via `changes`, derived include/exclude globs for core code only, `init`, one filled codemap.md per folder, `update`, a root atlas, and the Repository Map section registered in CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md.
expectations: The workflow resolves exactly one logical `SKILL_FOLDER` before the first script call and substitutes the quoted absolute path directly.
Step 1 executes `changes` for real and sets mode=init from the `No codemap state found` output.
The include/exclude globs exclude tests, docs, build output, and node_modules.
Every written codemap.md has the sections Responsibility, Design, Flow, and Integration with real paths.
`update` runs after the codemaps are written, and the root codemap.md links every folder codemap.

evals.prompt: Die Codemaps in diesem Repo sind veraltet, seit dem letzten Lauf wurden Dateien in src/config geändert und eine gelöscht. Bitte aktualisieren.
evals.expected_output: An incremental run: `changes` lists the affected folders, only those codemaps are updated section by section, the stale reference to the deleted file is removed, the root atlas row is refreshed, and `update` saves the new state.
expectations: Only the folders listed under `folders affected` receive edits; other codemap.md files stay untouched.
The existing src/config/codemap.md is read before editing and only the invalidated sections are rewritten.
The deleted file no longer appears in any codemap.
`update` runs after the edits so `.codemap/state.json` matches the new hashes.
The State Table shows mode=update and the affected_folders list.

evals.prompt: Prüfe, ob die Codemaps noch aktuell sind.
evals.expected_output: `changes` reports `No changes detected.`; the skill sets mode=noop, verifies the root atlas and the Repository Map registration, writes nothing else, and reports that in German.
expectations: No codemap.md is rewritten when the state reports no changes.
The root atlas and the Repository Map registration are still checked.
The German report states explicitly that nothing had to be mapped.
The run ends with the SKILL DONE banner, not with an abort.

evals.prompt: Erstelle Codemaps für dieses Monorepo mit apps/backend (TypeScript), apps/mobile (Dart) und einigen Python-Skripten in tools/.
evals.expected_output: Before scanning, the skill asks via `interviewe` which apps and directories to include, then derives scoped include globs from the answer and continues with the normal init flow.
expectations: An `interviewe` block (or a structured question tool) asks for scope and exclusions before `init` runs.
The include globs are scoped to the confirmed apps instead of mapping everything.
Tests, docs, and build output remain excluded for every language.
The workflow pauses until the user answers instead of assuming a scope.
